name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Confetti animations are best used to delight your users when something special happens.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the canvas. Size it yourself, e.g. absolute inset-0 size-full. Other attributes and listeners (e.g. @mouseenter) also go to the canvas.

props.name: options
props.description: Default options for every burst (particleCount, angle, spread, startVelocity, decay, gravity, drift, flat, ticks, origin, colors, shapes, scalar, zIndex).

props.name: manualstart
props.description: Don't fire a burst on mount.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content rendered after the canvas. It can call useConfetti() to get { fire }.

props.name: fire
props.description: Exposed through a template ref (and useConfetti()). Fires a burst on the canvas; per-call options override the options prop.

props.name: options
props.description: Burst options. The origin is always the centre of the button.

emits.name: click
emits.description: Native click, emitted before the burst. Call event.preventDefault() to skip the confetti.
